CustomField.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of the Prefill Template's field values. On load of a fresh Form Submission the formTemplate runtime parses this and applies it as the submission's starting state, unless Skip Prefill is true. Maintained by the prefill editor; not edited by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Holds the saved default values applied to new form submissions. Managed automatically by the Edit Prefilled Template editor; you normally do not edit this raw JSON directly.
CustomField.label: Prefill Values
